input_validation: XAX bits1 values extended to bytes 00/01
output: Status zero and exactly one byte 01 authorizes; every other response preserves native behavior
settings: Music > Account > Settings > YouTube Hide Ads > Settings > Player controls > Background playback
lifecycle: Read the saved independent switch on each eligible callback. Restart Music after changing it to discard native cached capabilities. No automatic restart or play command.
readiness: Both roles unique; reflection validates modifiers, reference argument and kids enum type; native policy/host self-checks pass; both methods and at most 128 direct callers per role deoptimize; both protective hooks install before ready becomes true

eligibility.literal_role: Background eligibility protobuf discriminator, shared with YouTube's existing structural contract
eligibility.context: Native result false, non-null reference argument, attached Music Application Context and readiness
eligibility.action: Return Boolean.TRUE only when BF authorizes; always preserve native true

kids_policy.literal_role: Morphe's Music kids background-policy experiment anchor; identifies the method, never a global experiment override
kids_policy.context: Non-null receiver and enum argument, attached Music Application Context and readiness
kids_policy.action: Skip only the uniquely resolved restriction controller when BF authorizes; otherwise proceed

preserved: native policy libraries and JNI ABI
failure: Missing/ambiguous roles, failed deoptimization, policy failure, missing host Context, disabled preference or partial installation leave both callbacks inactive or preserve the original call
startup_failure_isolation: A synchronous completed-future continuation captures discovery/installation exceptions, resets background readiness and allows Music ad/settings startup to continue on the same DexKit-owning thread.
